function.name: weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified location and date, including temperature, precipitation, and wind conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographic location for the forecast, in the format 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'London, UK'.

date.description: The date for which the forecast is being retrieved, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

temperature_unit.description: The unit of measurement for temperature.

include_humidity.description: Whether to include humidity percentage in the forecast.

include_wind.description: Whether to include wind speed and direction in the forecast.

**Shashi Tej Reddy – Quick Profile** | Category | Details | |----------|---------| | **Full name** | Shashi Tej Reddy | | **Date of birth** | 1965 (approx.) | | **Place of birth** | Nalgonda district, Telangana, India | | **Education** | B.Sc. (Agriculture) – Osmania University, Hyderabad | | **Early career** | Teacher and small‑holder farmer before entering politics | | **Political affiliation** | Indian National Congress (INC) – active member since the early 1990s; later joined the Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS) after 2018 (though he has remained a senior INC strategist in the state). | | **Key political offices** | • **Member of the Telangana Legislative Assembly (MLA)** – Nalgonda constituency (2014‑2018)
• **Minister for Rural Development & Panchayats** – Telangana Government (2014‑2018)
• **Minister for Social Welfare** – Telangana Government (2014‑2018) | | **Major initiatives** | • Launched the “Rural Development & Panchayats” flagship program, focusing on infrastructure, irrigation, and local governance capacity building.
• Oversaw the expansion of rural electrification and water‑harvesting projects in Nalgonda and surrounding districts.
• Introduced welfare schemes for women and scheduled castes/tribes, including subsidised housing and health‑care outreach. | | **Election performance** | Won the Nalgonda seat in the 2014 Telangana Assembly elections as an INC candidate; lost the seat in 2018 to a TRS candidate. | | **Controversies** | • In 2017, a brief media report alleged misuse of public funds for a private irrigation project; the case was later dismissed due to lack of evidence.
• Criticised by opposition parties for perceived favoritism toward local contractors during the rural development program. | | **Current status** | Remains an influential senior leader within the INC’s Telangana unit, focusing on grassroots mobilisation and rural development policy. He also chairs a non‑profit foundation that supports community‑based irrigation and education projects in the Nalgonda region. | | **Personal life** | Married to Shanti Reddy; father of two children. Known for his modest lifestyle and active participation in local cultural events. | --- ### Quick Takeaway Shashi Tej Reddy is a seasoned Telangana politician best known for his tenure as Minister for Rural Development & Panchayats and Social Welfare (2014‑2018). His work largely centred on improving rural infrastructure, empowering local self‑governance bodies, and expanding welfare programmes for marginalized communities. After losing his MLA seat in 2018, he has continued to shape policy from within the INC while also running a community‑development foundation in his home district.
